product_metadata.title: CJM Industries llc The Shower Tie - Quick Drying Silicone Shower Lanyard for dorms, Camping, The Gym, Cruises, Travel, hostels. TSA Approved, Rust Proof Rings (Black, 1)
features: WATERPROOF: Quick drying silicone, and stainless steel split rings
BOTTLES NOT INCLUDED: This listing is for the leash & split rings only
STRETCHY SILICONE: Easy to clean, dries quickly, slip resistant
Fits around shower heads, faucet knobs, and rods to keep your belongings off the shower floor.
4 RUST PROOF RINGS: easily attach your bottles, loofah and accessories of choice.
description: This stretchy silicone lanyard will go everywhere you do. Take it into dirty camp, dorm and gym showers to keep your shower bottles, loofah and other accessories at arms reach and off the floor. The quick drying stretchy silicone fits around shower heads, handles, and shower curtain rods. This lanyard comes with 4 stainless steel split rings that WILL NOT RUST. This lanyard is meant to get wet and dry quickly so you pack it up last minute when your late for your flight. This TSA approved product will make packing shampoo, conditioner, facial scrub, aftershave, sun tan lotion and other toiletries easier. Perfect gift for your high school graduate, nomadic hipster friend or gym lover.
